direct_value: the value with its unit, statistic, interval and basis (lithology zones or whole interval; n for a named statistic) first, then every supporting fact and limit that bears on it; no headings.
list: "## Answer" (the judgement and count), "## Intervals" (every qualifying interval with its class or grade, key values and what limits it), "## Data and Limitations", "## Conclusions".
report: "## Formation Overview" (interval, gross thickness, the zones by lithology and depth and how much of the interval they cover), one or more question-specific "## ..." sections, "## Data and Limitations", "## Conclusions" (the judgement restated with the key zones and values).
